title: Cards
description: Cards — a photo, photos or an icon, a title, labels, a text, a link — in a grid two, three or four across, in a carousel, or one at a time beside the words; the photo across the card or under its words.

schema.label: Heading
schema.help: Two equals signs around words set them off in the accent colour: Homes ==by the river==.

schema.label: Button
schema.help: Under the words above the cards.

schema.label: Button link
schema.help: A page, an address, or a file from the library to download. The address #webx-form-<slug> opens that form of the inbox in a dialog.

schema.label: Across, at most
schema.help: In the grid and in the carousel; a narrow column shows fewer.

schema.label: Pictures
schema.help: Under the words: the photo fills the card, the title, the text and the link words stand on glass over its foot.

schema.label: View
schema.help: Words beside a carousel: the heading, the text and the button on one side, the cards one at a time on the other, with a line for each under them.

schema.label: Start over after the last card
Turn on its own
schema.help: Stops under the mouse and in focus, has a pause button, and does not start for a visitor who asked for less motion.

children.label: More photos
children.help: With two photos or more, a photo card turns them on its own every 5 seconds, with a bar for each; an icon card shows the first picture only.

children.label: Labels
children.help: A few short words under the title: 2 rooms, 54 m², a balcony.

children.label: Link words
children.help: Shown under the text; the whole card is the link.

children.label: Link address (old)
children.help: What this button had before it took a link. Used only while the link above is empty: choose the link, then clear this.

schema.label: Without animation
schema.help: Shown at once, even where the theme brings its blocks in as the page scrolls.

schema.label: Slide over the section above
schema.help: The section above stays in place while this one comes up over it, and its words fade. The edge pictures stand over this section's top. Visitors who ask for less motion see the sections one after another.

schema.label: Edge picture
schema.help: Over the top of this section, as wide as the page: fog or clouds in a PNG or WebP with transparency, its bottom row in the colour of this section.

schema.label: Edge picture on a phone
schema.help: The same edge for a narrow screen. Without it the edge picture above is used there too.

sample.heading: What we do
sample.intro: Three things, each with a page of its own.

cards.title: Planning
cards.text: A route and a date before anything moves.

cards.title: Delivery
cards.text: Door to door, with one person answering for it.

cards.title: Storage
cards.text: For a week or a season.
